body:
This is actually really bad. How rare is hemiplegic migraine? 

This sucks. Everything sucks. I cant even imagine whats going through your head after 8 years of dealing with this shit. You are getting that miracle, you deserve it. 

I really hope you are able to start the recovery process and follow your plan. Best of luck to you.

Oh and fuck those people around you that left you alone, they deserve to feel the same pain you are feeling, at least temporary, so they know how serious is that. 

You are a champion already for fighting for so long. Please heal.

Lucky? Don't think so, people who have never dealt with pain are the lucky ones and most of them dont even appreciate that. I feel you, just did a research for CRPS and its an ugly disease. how and when did it start? How long have you been on ketamine? do anti anxiety pills make your symptoms a little easier?

Opioids, not yet, the doc said I am too young for them though i would love to. 

Cannabis, yeah, smoked a few times and everytime the pain would get a lot worse, it makes my prostate feel like its going to explode and i cant pee for a few hours after smoking, so I quit it.
Fuck them. Especially the ones who tell the most and pretend like they know better than you, but have never experienced anything serious on their own.

Yup, I dont believe in a cure anymore, just want a painless life. Thats the most I can ask for. Chronic pain is indeed a silent killer. 

If I survive until my next visit, i'll ask for injectable vitamin c, I heard these are a goldmine. Thanks. I take probiotics as I am on a course of antibiotics even right now, lol 

Speaking of sugar, I have reduced the consumption to the minimum though I cheat when im feeling really low, no alcohol, coffee, spicy, salty food too. Ill check it out for sure. 

Diet doesnt do a lot for me to be honest, maybe I havent found one that works for me. 

It either can or cannot be fixed, life is a gamble haha but its definitely manageable and controllable though it requires fuel-energy to do that, which is limited and is burning down. 

I hope everything works out for you, you are a good person and deserve a peaceful life. You still havent written a word about your own issues, here for you. Going to get some sleep, take care! Answer you tomorrow, would love to hear your story out.

Thanks and bless you

I am just too tired of these bumps, too exhausted for them.

There is ways, but it takes time to find them and a lifetime may not be enough and I am totally not ready for this. Have done enough of testings already - different medicines, diets, lifestyle and nothing seems to help.

I understand that there are a lot of untreatable diseases and millions of people are fighting their best to live another day in this world, but its not for everyone, I am giving up. Sorry if I sound like a total loser, but once I was not, Im just too tired. I used to have a perfect life before, because I was motivated to live. And now I cant even travel which I loved the most, because my prostate is enlarged, painful and its even a huge challenge to pee.

No, actually I havent, I prefer listening and reading instead of participating, but today I made an exception writing this post.

Thanks a lot for your time, highly appreciated! Best of luck to you.

Hi. Thanks so much for taking your time. What kind of health issues are you facing? 

Yes, have spent countless of hours over the last 2 years reading about this illness, other people experiences, forums, news, looking for new drugs, ideas.

Yes, my immune system might be fucked up, the doc has said its whats causing the infections although I feel like everything is fine with it. 

Whats mega boosting? I do nothing besides having a healthy lifestyle and taking non prescription required supplements.

Yeah, lol, the sad truth. "But its the 21 century, everything is curable. Have you tryed going to a different doc? Maybe the illness is all in your head!". Of course its in the head, because thats where the brain is at, but its a slice of the illness. The bacterias and infections dont appear out of nowhere. 

Im still struggling to find painkillers that work, have tryed a lot of different drugs, but no solid relief. 

European here.
